comments.author: @UnrealEarthJourneys
comments.text: The Cai Rang floating market scenes really stayed with me — whole families living, trading and raising kids on the water, with the boat as both home and shop. How do they handle the rainy season when the river rises?

comments.author: @Bridget-m7d
comments.text: So proud to see Cai Rang and Phung Hiep floating markets featured! Seeing generations live, trade, and dream on wooden boats along the Mekong is so touching.
